name: Planetario de Bogotá

headline.t: a link in its TLS chain.

body: nosniff, framing limited to its origin, a declared language, and a 301 from http to https. But the server leaves out the Sectigo intermediate certificate. Browsers patch it in; Node.js and API clients refuse.
lesson: Install the full chain your certificate authority provides, then test with openssl s_client or SSL Labs.
summary: planetariodebogota.gov.co scores 78 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 27 are at risk, and 15 pass. Fix first: 20 pages have no meta description.

fix.title: 20 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /mision-y-vision, /ubicacion, /historia and 16 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Universal Analytics code is still on the page
fix.evidence: Google stopped processing Universal Analytics data in July 2024. The code adds weight and collects nothing.
fix.fix: Remove the UA- tag and keep GA4.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: 13 pages do not have exactly one h1
fix.fix: Give each page one h1 that names it.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 315 ms
